items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1960-09-28
items.q: He hung around there, huh? Yeah, he used to come in there and sing all those numbers he made up.

ctx.x: A case he put on for that green old hill. A 41 striking line in the face. The switchman knew that by the engine moan. The man at the trolley was Casey Jones. Casey Jones. I got another popper. Casey Jones. On the Salt Lake line. Casey Jones. I got another popper. I got another popper. On the Salt Lake line. Casey Jones. I got another popper to softly learn.
Here's some more. Where did Rabbit sing Downfall of the Lion?

Yeah, the Tom Anderson Cabaret. He hung around there, huh? Yeah, he used to come in there and sing all those numbers he made up. And he made up another song about Gypsy Blood, the time they had all that killing down there. He had several little songs right there.
